display-small.purpose: Retained theme role using bundled offline Literata; no longer used for the library introduction.

headline-large.purpose: Library question, vocabulary and activity introductions, and saved-word sheet heading.

headline-medium.purpose: App bar titles, meanings, and weekly total.

headline-small.purpose: Sections, empty states, continuing-book title, and word translation.

title-medium.purpose: Book rows, settings groups, reader context, and result chapter.

components.name: Filled Button
components.description: Native Compose Material 3 Button; switches to button-primary-dark with the theme. Used for language download, vocabulary save, and optional connection save. Material owns shape, ripple, focus, enabled and disabled states. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Tonal Button
components.description: Native FilledTonalButton for review and saving a highlight; framework role colors, shape and interaction states. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Native OutlinedButton for optional Gemini connection and its inline form disclosure, and personal translation save. Translation/dictionary retry use TextButton. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Native TextButton for dialog decisions, lower emphasis actions, translation/dictionary retry, original/additional-meaning disclosure, and reading reset. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Outlined Field
components.description: Native OutlinedTextField for search, optional connection, personal translation, and notes. Search is single line; translation allows up to four lines and lookup notes up to five. The encrypted personal key uses password transformation and visibility control; provider, model, and endpoint stay under advanced disclosure. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Adaptive Navigation
components.description: Native NavigationBar below 600dp and NavigationRail from 600dp; four labeled destinations. Hidden during reading. Settings groups lead to Lectura, Diccionario y traducción, and Gemini. PrimaryTabRow separates lookup tasks and reading preferences. Optional Gemini settings from lookup opens a full-screen native dialog; back returns to the same book. Selection, ripple and focus stay Material defaults. Library bottom safe-drawing insets keep its import FAB above the expanded-window taskbar. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Selection and Action Chips
components.description: Native FilterChip for filters, application theme, reading font/background, margins, and paragraph spacing; AssistChip for explicit Gemini explanation, grammar, and simpler-English actions in Contexto, disabled during lookup. FlowRow wraps variable groups. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Continue Reading Card
components.description: Native clickable Card with explicit paired primary-container colors, 16dp corners, 20dp padding, 98 by 148dp cover, reading context and progress; resume-card-dark is its dark variant. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Meaning Sheet
components.description: Native fully expanded ModalBottomSheet with fixed word/optional pronunciation/speech/close header, stable Significado or Traducción / Contexto / Notas tabs, scrollable body, and fixed vocabulary save for translated selections up to 12 words. Local translation retains official Google Translate attribution and one-time Wi-Fi/mobile-data download choices. Wiktionary provides grammatical categories, up to four senses (two initially), examples, English-original disclosure, entry and CC BY-SA 4.0 links, and separate loading/error/cache states. Spanish definitions use local automatic translation when available. Contexto holds the sentence and optional Gemini actions; Notas holds notes, highlights and personal translation when no result exists. Saved meanings retain dictionary credit. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Reading Surface
components.description: Isolated Android WebView with reading background following the app or independently Claro/Oscuro; bundled offline Literata or sans serif, 16–32 CSS px preference and 1.4–2.2 line height. Android fontScale drives WebView textZoom. Centered page width up to 740 CSS px; margins 12/28/44 CSS px, paragraph spacing .5/1/1.5em and optional justification. Tap consultation is optional; long press and native Traducir remain available. Keep-screen-on and gesture-hint preferences are separate. A live native preview shares Texto/Página/Controles preferences with the fully expanded scrollable appearance sheet. Reading reset preserves app theme, books and credentials. Selection/highlights use paired theme containers; blockquotes use surface-container, dividers use outline-variant, and error fallback uses current page colors. h2 retains flow-root, 1em top padding, and .7em bottom margin. Native component: no fabricated HTML/CSS preview.

narrative.overview:
Lectio pairs graphite surfaces, slate layers, and soft blue actions with literary headings and clear native controls. Dark is the initial theme; explicit Claro and Sistema preferences remain available and persisted. Reading and contextual understanding share one space: tapping a word opens translation and real dictionary meanings in a native sheet, with separate context and notes tabs; selecting a phrase opens translation. The library asks “¿Qué te gustaría leer?” without promotional support copy. Local translation needs a one-time language download; Gemini explanations stay behind explicit optional actions. Local use requires no account.

This is a code-led record of the native Android Compose implementation, not a reference composition. Compose dimensions use dp and text uses sp; the isolated EPUB WebView has its own CSS reading surface. Native components in the JSON sidecar are descriptive records, not HTML/CSS previews. Token frontmatter is normative; framework defaults remain owned by Material 3, and implementation limitations below are not new design rules.
keyCharacteristics: Modern graphite dark surfaces, slate containers, soft blue actions, and a cool light scheme.
Serif literary headings with sans serif functional text.
Material 3 controls, tonal containers, and native modal sheets.
Adjustable reading type, page and controls, with a live preview and visible dictionary/translation provenance.
Four destinations that adapt from bottom navigation to a rail.

rules.name: The Paired Roles Rule
rules.body: Resolve UI colors through MaterialTheme.colorScheme and use the foreground role corresponding to its background role.

rules.name: The Two Reading Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the Compose type roles for app UI; allow the separate reading page to follow the reader's serif/sans, size, and line-height preferences.

rules.name: The Navigation Width Rule
rules.body: Use the existing compact bar / expanded rail boundary; do not copy the compact bar onto the expanded layout.

dos: Do use Material 3 color roles with matching foregrounds in both explicit schemes.
Do use serif headline roles and sans serif functional type through `LectioTypography`.
Do retain the compact navigation bar and expanded navigation rail behavior.
Do keep reading preferences separate from app UI typography.
Do preserve visible translation provenance, one-time download choices, and explicit optional explanation actions in the reading context.
Do use native Material controls and their built-in interaction states.
donts: Don't treat fallback cover colors as general app accents or reintroduce fixed warm colors into themed reader content.
Don't promote tiny uppercase cover labels into a reusable heading pattern.
Don't describe framework defaults as custom Lectio shadow, shape, motion, or error tokens.
Don't introduce account UI as a prerequisite to local reading or vocabulary.
Don't present Android 15 emulator touch/long-press or DOM phrase-selection tests as physical-phone, selection-handle, TalkBack, live Gemini, TTS, or performance verification.
